# Shop

A small Spring Boot sample used to test CodeAtlas.

## Modules

### Orders

Orders are created through `POST /orders` and read through `GET /orders/{id}`.

### Payments

Payments go through an external gateway via a Feign client.

## Running locally

Start the app with `./mvnw spring-boot:run`.

# a heading inside a code fence is not a section
